(In the clubroom…)

Yuri: “I had a pretty crazy dream last night…”

Natsuki: “Oh? What was it about, Yuri? Anything interesting?”

Yuri: “Well, it was a bit…weird, Natsuki. I dreamt that our personalities were switched around. I was acting like a tsundere, and you were acting like a yandere. You even had a knife collection! And I was the one with a sweet tooth!”

(In Yuri’s dream…)

Yuri: “
sample.chosen:
That sounds like quite an unusual dream, Yuri! So, in this dream, how did the others react to the personality swap? Did they notice something was off right away, or did it take some time for them to figure it out?"

(In Yuri's dream...)

Natsuki (Yandere): "Yuri, you seem different today. Are you feeling okay? You're being so... sweet."

Yuri (Tsundere): "I-It's not like I'm being sweet or anything, b-baka! I just felt like having some cupcakes, that's all!"

Monika: "Girls, something feels off about you two today. Yuri, you're never this defensive, and Natsuki, since when do you have a knife collection?"

Sayori: "Yeah, and why are you so eager to use them, Natsuki? It's scaring me a little..."

Natsuki (Yandere): "Oh, Sayori, don't be silly. I just thought it would be fun to show you all my new hobby. Isn't it exciting?"

Yuri (Tsundere): "N-Not really, Natsuki. It's kinda creepy. A-And stop calling me sweet! I-I'm not!"

(Back in the clubroom...)

Natsuki: "Wow, that is quite the dream, Yuri! I can't imagine you as a tsundere, and I definitely can't see myself as a yandere. Knives are way too dangerous!"

Yuri: "I know, right? It was such a strange experience. But it made me appreciate our normal personalities more."

Natsuki: "Well, I'm glad you're back to your usual self, Yuri. I don't think I could handle you being a tsundere all the time."

Yuri: "And I certainly couldn't handle you being a yandere, Natsuki. Let's just stick to being ourselves."

Natsuki: "Agreed! Now, who wants some cupcakes? I made extra today."

Yuri: "I'd love one, Natsuki. Thanks."

(The club members enjoy their cupcakes, appreciating each other's unique personalities.)
